name: First Dates Australia
description: When the First Dates restaurant sets the table, hopeful singles from across the country will have a chance of meeting their dream partner. They’ve turned their backs on online dating in the hope of meeting someone special face-to-face, and they’ll meet their potential love match for the very first time in the restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: There's someone out there for everyone, and when the first dates restaurant sets the table, singles from across the country will have a chance of meeting their dream partner.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: They've come from right across the country to face the most intense night of their lives. On this episode, a dater returns. Will she find true love?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A pretty PA is back to give love another chance and an Aussie Magic Mike leaves a lasting impression on his date.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tonight, a real-life Magic Mike looks for love, and two twins take to the First Dates restaurant. Another dater returns, but can she get past her date's love of cats and find love?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tonight, a man with a love of Home And Away meets his match in an aspiring journalist. Also, a single mother goes on her first date in many years and a young teen has her first date ever.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tonight, a travelling circus performer, stuntman and racehorse trainer go in search of love. Plus, a girl who followed the yellow brick road to be here - will she find Mr Right in Oz?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tonight, Anthony scores a second First Date. Will the luck of the Irish be on his side? And will it be destiny when a celebrity psychic medium meets an intuitive healer?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In the series final of First Dates, will a magician cast a spell on his date and will a music student hit the right notes during her romantic meal?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: First Dates Australia is the heart-warming, heart-breaking and occasionally heart-stopping fly-on-the-wall dating series, that takes viewers inside the intimate world of genuine first dates.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Come along for the ride as singles settle in for genuine blind dates. Everyone can relate to the promise of potential love when it goes well and the hilariously awkward moments if it crashes and burns

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: For the first time in First Dates history, it’s an unprecedented date swap. Can model Tyler handle independent woman Kristal, or will his head be turned by someone else? And will comedian Diana be able to snort laugh her way to true love? Fiery barber Katelyn brings some scissors in her bag in case her date has a bad haircut, while DJ Ryan does his best to doof doof his way into Kierra’s heart. Who will end the night on a kiss, and who will be left speechless?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview:
Tonight on First Dates, could kooky crystal girl Angelique find her perfect match in fun-loving James? Will glamorous globetrotter Steph hold the key to dog groomer Chad’s heart?

One lucky lady gets a chance at love with fan fav, and sexiest NRL footy hero Matt Cooper. And it’s just like a rom-com when old-fashioned Kosha meets boyfriend material, Luke.

Love is in the air, but which of our four couples will be struck by Cupid’s arrow?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: There's magic in the air tonight in the First Dates restaurant. From health-conscious vegans to prowling cougars, it's all here. And will a potential proposal send one dater running for the door?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A mother-daughter double date hunts for love. Elsewhere, sparks fly between massage therapist Jason and pole dance instructor Jessica, while music lovers Adrian and Zara seek harmony.
